report.title: Campaign report
report.recipientCount: {count, plural, =0 {no recipients} one {# recipient} other {# recipients}}

clicked.label: Clicked
clicked.hint: Share of delivered messages where somebody clicked a link. The most reliable number in this report.

delivered.label: Delivered
delivered.hintProvider: Deliveries are reported by the sending service.
delivered.hintDerived: The sending service does not report deliveries. This number is derived: sent minus rejected and failed.
delivered.hintUnknown: The sending service has not told us anything about what happened to these emails yet. Until it does, we do not measure deliveries, bounces or complaints.

opens.heading: Opens
opens.clickedFromVerified: {count, plural, =0 {None of the verified opens clicked a link.} one {One verified open also clicked a link.} other {# verified opens also clicked a link.}}
opens.warning: Some opens are produced by mail apps on their own, without anybody reading the message. The reliable number is clicks.
opens.explainBody: An open is detected when a mail app downloads a small invisible image. Since 2021 Apple Mail and other apps download it up front, on their own, before anybody reads the message. The tool cannot tell the difference.
opens.explainAdvice: Look at clicks. A click needs a human. Opens are still good for one thing: somebody who opened nothing for a year is almost certainly inactive.

verifiedRate.label: Verified opens
verifiedRate.hint: Calculated only from recipients where measurement works.

toggle.label: Subtract likely machine opens
toggle.onDescription: Showing verified opens only. The denominator is delivered without Apple Mail recipients.
toggle.offDescription: Showing all opens including likely machine ones. The number is inflated by that.

predicted.label: Estimated real opens
predicted.hint: This is not a measurement. It is derived from the part of the audience Apple does not distort.

problems.heading: Problems
problems.notReportedBody: Bounces and complaints are reported back by the sending service. This account does not send them, so we know nothing about them. That is a missing value, not a zero.
problems.noEventsBody: Not a single report came back from the sending service for this campaign, so we know nothing about deliveries, bounces or complaints. That is a missing value, not a zero. Check in Settings whether the sending account has delivery notifications configured.

links.heading: What people clicked
links.clicks: {count, plural, =0 {no clicks} one {# click} other {# clicks}}
links.duplicate: Same address as another link in the e-mail
links.empty: The campaign had no measured link.

systemLinks.heading: Clicks on footer links
systemLinks.none: Nobody has clicked a footer link yet.
systemLinks.notInClickRate: This counts how many recipients opened the link. It is deliberately kept out of the click rate: unsubscribing is not interest in the message, and a mixed number could not be compared with any other tool.

chart.heading: Over time
chart.compacted: Data older than 30 days is stored hourly, finer resolution is no longer available.
chart.omittedDelivered: The Delivered series is not in the chart. The sending service reports nothing about delivery, so it would be a zero instead of a measurement.
chart.omittedOpens: The Opens series is not in the chart. Open tracking is turned off for this campaign.
chart.omittedClicks: The Clicks series is not in the chart. Click tracking is turned off for this campaign.

diagnostics.heading: Diagnostics
diagnostics.scannerClicksHint: Corporate spam filters visit every link to check it. We do not count those clicks.
diagnostics.deliveredSourceProvider: Delivery is reported by the sending service.
diagnostics.deliveredSourceDerived: The sending service does not report delivery, so it is counted as sent minus rejected.
diagnostics.deliveredSourceUnknown: The sending service has sent us nothing about what happened to the messages, so delivery is not measured at all.

sentPreview.heading: What was actually sent
sentPreview.readOnly: This preview is read-only. It shows the version stored at send time, so changing the template will not change it.
sentPreview.subject: Subject
sentPreview.notCompiledTitle: The content has not been prepared yet
sentPreview.notCompiledBody: This campaign has no stored sent version yet. It is created when the content is prepared for sending, and from then on this is exactly what the recipients got.
sentPreview.emptyContentBody: The campaign contained no content block, only the system footer. Recipients therefore received an empty e-mail and the preview below shows exactly what they got.
sentPreview.systemLinksNote: The unsubscribe, preferences and web version links are inactive in this preview. Every recipient got their own personal ones and the report does not recreate them.
sentPreview.failed: The sent version of the campaign could not be loaded.

banner.sending: Sending in progress, numbers keep changing
banner.progress: The campaign is still sending, {sent} of {total}
banner.settling: Numbers are still settling. Most opens and clicks arrive within the first hour.
banner.stopped: Sending was stopped after {sent} of {total} e-mails. Percentages are calculated from sent, not from the original audience.
banner.deletedContacts: Some contacts from this campaign were deleted. Totals still hold, but you cannot drill down to individual people.
banner.liveUnavailable: Live updates are failing, we refresh the numbers every 15 seconds.

states.draft: The report becomes available once the campaign is sent.
states.justSent: Sending has just started, the first data appears within seconds.
states.trackingOffOpens: Open tracking was disabled for this campaign
states.trackingOffClicks: Click tracking was disabled for this campaign
states.trackingOffBody: Tracking was disabled for this campaign, that is why the numbers are missing.
states.error: The report could not be loaded.
states.smallSample: Small sample, percentages may be misleading
states.notComputed: The summary for this campaign has not been computed yet. The numbers below are zeros from an empty summary, not measurements. The sending progress screen shows how many messages actually went out.

actions.resendWarning: Opens are imprecise, so the audience will include people who did read the e-mail. Consider wording other than „you missed it“.
actions.duplicateFailed: The campaign could not be duplicated: {detail}
actions.segmentFromClicked: Create a segment from people who clicked
actions.segmentFromNotOpened: Create a segment from people who did not open
actions.showUndelivered: Show who did not receive it
